text:
Jordan L: confidential — I have an auditory processing disorder and I need an accommodation for the upcoming performance cycle. Can we set an alternative feedback format? Prefer written-only feedback where possible and scheduled 1:1s. Not comfortable discussing publicly.
Asha (People Ops): thanks for flagging, @Jordan L. We can handle this here but will keep it confidential. Do you want a private DM or is this thread ok? Also, when does the review cycle start?
Jordan L: leaving in thread for timestamp. Reviews start Apr 10, 2026. Main issue: ad-hoc verbal feedback in standups and live code reviews causes overload — I freeze and it affects my responses.
Priya S: @Jordan L I wasn't aware, thanks for telling us. Totally fine to adjust. Jordan, what concrete changes would help day-to-day?
Jordan L: async PR comments instead of live critique, 24h notice + agenda for any live review, topics for 1:1 sent ahead. For calibration sessions I can do written answers or recorded responses.
Asha (People Ops): sounds reasonable. We'll draft a brief accommodation plan (trial for the review cycle) and post for your consent. Priya, can you implement the meeting/PR changes on the team side? Please keep this limited to direct managers and HR.
Priya S: absolutely. I'll update meeting invites with agendas and ask leads to post topics in advance. For PRs I'll switch to written comments and tag @Jordan L for follow-up. If you'd like, I can also remind folks before standups to avoid surprise feedback.
Jordan L: thank you — also can I be exempted from the live calibration on Apr 18? I can provide written responses or a short recorded summary instead.
Marta (HR): adding here so it's tracked — we'll note this in the accommodation tracker as an informal/temporary plan unless Jordan wants to formalize via ADA paperwork. Either is fine; Marta can start the interactive process if you prefer.
Jordan L: trial period works for now. Please document it so managers know.
Asha (People Ops): we'll draft and share the plan in this thread within 24 hours and set a check-in for Apr 20 to see how it's going. @Priya S can you confirm you'll update calendars and meeting templates by EOD Wed?
Priya S: will do.
Jordan L: really appreciate it, thank you :relieved:
Asha (People Ops): one more note — if anything feels like it's slipping or public comments happen, DM me or @Marta (HR) and we'll follow up. Keeping this low-friction is the goal.
Jordan L: got it, thanks again.
